Table legend
 X means the Attribute is applicable to this Class of ECU Signal and shall be
configured.
o Xl means the Age Attribute applicable is the Lifetime.
o Xd means the Age Attribute applicable is the Delay.
 F means the Attribute is applicable to this Class of ECU Signal but it is a fixed
standard value.
 O means the Attribute is optional to this Class of ECU Signal and depends on
a static configuration (disable/enable).
 - means the Attribute is not applicable or has no meaning to this Class of ECU
Signal.
